verdict.rationale: Evidence covers Paxos's own stablecoins (USDG, PYUSD, USDP) and generic mint/redeem/convert APIs for moving between USD and existing Paxos-issued stablecoins, but there is no documented product letting a founder launch their own branded stablecoin on Paxos infrastructure, no described reserve-management workflow for a new issuer, and no gating/pricing/eligibility information for such an offering.
